C round 334 is PASS, with no bugs found. Every browser, perf and mutation row passed on A's tree against HEAD `3f945e3`. The full vitest, build, Biome, typecheck, `npm run verify` and e2e smoke rows belong to the root gate, so I didn't run them or claim them. Browser checks ran at both 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` is true.

- **Unit tests and mutants:** the four targeted test files passed 95/95 on three runs. All 9 of B's mutants go red on exactly the expected rows, and my own mutant (video branch disabled) goes red on WZ1 and WZ4.
- **Re-render counts:** the counts match B's sketch (`fade-moves` 10, `move-moves` 19/19/101/19). Compared with HEAD, only `ArrangementPeakPathInner` disappears and nothing new appears.
- **Perf:** the run on a production build passed 36/36 asserted rows. 104 rows are equal to round 333 and 17 are lower, all matching B's sketch values, and `hook-live` reads 1.
- **Waveforms:** the drawn path matches HEAD at all 22 samples at both viewports. That includes my own trim-end drag at both viewports and the video clip at 1× and 4× zoom, move and Undo.
- **Export:** the WAV sha256 is identical to HEAD's at both viewports. The file is 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo, 118.815 s, with real audio from 41.91 s.
- **Auth:** an anonymous visit to `/studio-lab` opens the demo, `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required", and `/api/studio-token` with no header returns 401. Premium auth is not bypassed.
- **Docs:** doc 232 matches the contract, and every test id it cites exists.

**Two retries, both valid:**
- The first auth run timed out on a cold compile of the legacy route, so I kept it as environment-invalid and reran.
- My 1280×720 trim-end drag first hit the fade-out handle on both trees; a drag at the handle's lower part trimmed correctly and matched HEAD.

A's code-reviewer left three Low test-hardening notes (WG9 undefined guard, DP47/DP48 order, DP43 detail check). I left them as candidates for B, not bugs.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- `c-round-334.md`
- `c-round-334.json`
- `c-round-334/`
